checkpoint_validation_note: The pipeline checked tensor finiteness and SHA256 before evaluation; this audit checked that record and the current file size, without rehashing the checkpoint.
video_validation: All 500 expected episode files exist and are nonempty; this audit did not decode every video.

caught_expert_check_exceptions.interpretation: All 20 tracebacks arose in TASK_ENV.play_once before policy rollout, were caught, and advanced the seed. Each task then completed 10 scored policy trials. These are not the total number of skipped seeds; expert failures without exceptions are also skipped.

training_loss_note: Every 50 updates, rank 0 final microbatch L1 action loss; not an accumulated global-batch or held-out validation average.
